#!/bin/bash
source /opt/vyatta/etc/functions/script-template
configure
set interfaces ethernet eth1 address 10.10.10.1/24
set service dns forwarding listen-address 10.10.10.1
set service dns forwarding allow-from 10.10.10.0/24
set service dns forwarding name-server 1.1.1.1
set service dns forwarding authoritative-domain inventory.internal records a '@' address 10.10.10.2
commit
save
exit

---
- name: Configure VyOS DNS forwarding on node1
  hosts: vyos_router
  gather_facts: no
  tasks:
    - name: Push and run VyOS configuration script
      ansible.builtin.script: files/vyos_dns.sh
      register: vyos_result
      changed_when: "'Commit failed' not in vyos_result.stdout"
      failed_when: "vyos_result.rc != 0 or 'Commit failed' in vyos_result.stdout"

    - name: Show script output
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: vyos_result.stdout_lines

- name: Configure RHEL DNS clients to resolve through node1
  hosts: rhel_clients
  gather_facts: no
  vars:
    lan_ips:
      node2: 10.10.10.2
      node3: 10.10.10.3
  tasks:
    - name: Configure lan connection with static IP and node1 as DNS
      community.general.nmcli:
        conn_name: "Wired connection 2"
        ifname: enp8s0
        type: ethernet
        method4: manual
        ip4: "{{ lan_ips[inventory_hostname] }}/24"
        dns4:
          - 10.10.10.1
        dns4_search:
          - inventory.internal
        dns4_ignore_auto: true
        autoconnect: true
        state: present

    - name: Activate lan connection
      ansible.builtin.command: nmcli connection up "Wired connection 2"
      changed_when: true

    - name: Stop mgmt connection from supplying its own DNS
      community.general.nmcli:
        conn_name: "Wired connection 1"
        ifname: enp1s0
        type: ethernet
        method4: auto
        dns4_ignore_auto: true
        dns4: []
        state: present

    - name: Reapply mgmt connection settings without dropping the link
      ansible.builtin.command: nmcli device reapply enp1s0
      changed_when: true
